rules.centring: Read on the size_matched swap, pooled over bodies 0, 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 (body 2 left out by the operator's decision of Sep 25), for each of vision, tactile, audio and proprioception whose real next-token change is measurable at that phase, at each of the 5 hold phases, under heads_fp32, offset_subtracted and offset_subtracted_mean_matched: MET when the condition's own-command reading AND its paired difference from the production_bf16 reading on the same transitions are each above z times their bootstrap standard error, where z is the one-sided normal line for 5 in 100 shared over the comparisons made (at most 4 senses x 5 phases x 3 forms = 60, z = 3.14). Met by any one: the repair is centring the prediction heads' input.
rules.motor_token: The motor token's held-out R^2 for the asked position change or the asked turn (the 25 body handles pooled, bodies 0, 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7, each held out in turn) above both the 97.5th percentile of the same R^2 over 100 row permutations of the targets (5 in 100 shared over the two groups) and 0.04, one handle's share of the 25 pooled handles: the motor token carries the command. Not above both lines for either group: the motor token's R^2 is near its shuffled control (at most one handle's share), so the repair is the motor encoder or a direct command input. Judged only when the positive control (the motor encoder's input position columns: achieved and command position of the 26 handles) reaches R^2 0.9 on the asked position change.
rules.neither: Neither rule points to a repair (the centring rule not met and the motor token carrying the command): the contrast-loss route, a loss on the main route that is lower when the own command's error is below the size_matched command's, with its margin set from this run's measured size_matched reading and its noise before it is demanded. Both met: both repairs are indicated and recorded.
rules.reported_not_judged: The production_bf16 reading at every phase (the hold-phase effect behind the analysis's first finding), the absolute_roll and noise swaps, the per-body readings, the command shift share, the heads' attention weights, and the R^2 of the transformer's motor slot and of every head's input (where the command is lost between the motor token and the heads).
rules.reachability: 8 bodies x 250 transitions = 400 transitions a phase, 350 in the decision pool. From the live audit's window spread (40 transitions a window), the standard error at 350 is 0.000164 for proprioception, 0.000626 for audio, 1.76e-06 for tactile and 0.0268 for vision, so the smallest rise the rule can declare (z = 3.14 times it) is 0.00052, 0.002, 5.5e-06 and 0.084 of the reading's 0-to-1 scale. H71's pooled proprioception reading of 0.08 is 155 times proprioception's line, so a dependence of H71's size at any phase is declared; today's live reading at phase 4 (proprioception -0.00007) is not. The motor token: the position columns of the encoder's input hold the asked position change as a linear function (200 x (command position / 200 cm minus achieved position / 200 cm)), and a training fold's 300 distinct commands (each held 5 model steps) determine its 78 command-position columns, so the positive control reaches R^2 near 1 (the tests: above 0.99 on a fixture of independent commands, at least 0.9 on a fixture with 5-model-step holds); a token that kept one handle's command of the 25 reaches 1/25 = 0.04 of the pooled group's variance when the 25 handles' asked changes are of equal size, the rule's size line; the permuted control at 1,750 rows and 192 features had a 97.5th percentile of 0.00004 to 0.00005 on a token without information (Oct 2, this code), so the control line alone would credit a token that reads 0.00004.
